text: Modern 20-span (x80 km) long-haul systems reach OSNR ~ 20-22 dB and run DP-16QAM at ~7 bits/s/Hz. Relative to the nonlinear Shannon limit, they operate within about:
explanation: State-of-the-art long-haul links sit within roughly 2-3 dB of the nonlinear Shannon limit. Operating exactly at the limit is impossible with finite-complexity coding, and 20 dB or 50 dB would represent enormous, uncompetitive shortfalls compared with today's near-capacity systems.
